{{Top|leg}}
The '''R-UR4''' was a repair [[Drone/Legends|drone]] produced by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] during the [[Galactic War]] that could be carried as a payload by [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. The R-UR4 gradually repaired the hulls of nearby allies, and could be upgraded to replenish shield power and ammunition as well.
